role: Declares HealthKitServiceProtocol, the @MainActor abstraction of HealthKitManager used by MorningProcessingService, SessionAcceptanceService, ReanalysisService, HRVAnalysisPipeline and SleepBoundaryResolver so tests can inject MockHealthKitService; adds default-argument conveniences and the HealthKitManager conformance bridges.
types: HealthKitServiceProtocol: extension — default-argument conveniences and nap default 0
toplevel: HealthKitManager declares conformance (167). Protocol also requires properties isHealthKitAvailable (nonisolated) and authorizationRequested.

flags.text: Most protocol requirements are never dispatched through the protocol: production consumers holding `any HealthKitServiceProtocol` call only fetchSleepData, fetchDaytimeNapMinutes, fetchDaytimeRestingHR, calculateTrainingLoad(relativeTo:), fetchRecoveryVitals(relativeTo:), estimateSleepFromHealthKitHR and exportSessionMetrics; requestAuthorization, start/stopObservingSleepData, fetchLastNightSleep, fetchVO2Max(Trend), fetchHeartRateSamples, exportSleepToHealthKit, calculateTrainingMetrics, hasWorkoutInRange, findAdditionalSleepRange, fetchSleepTrend, analyzeSleepTrend, calculateHRStats and authorizationRequested are reached only on concrete HealthKitManager, so they only force MockHealthKitService to stub them.
